svg.title: A Three-Person Core with Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-funding-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: A Three-Person Core with Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Conservative and Base Case use 1 FT + 2 C; Scaled Small-Team uses 2 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time operator; C means contractor. Each node represents one person, not one full-time equivalent. The first three seats form the core pod; the last two are added only for the Scaled Small-Team scenario. Settlement agents and capital providers remain external counterparties rather than hidden pod headcount.; caption: Owner authorization and independent wire verification remain separate at both sizes. Automation assembles evidence and flags exceptions; it never independently changes beneficiary instructions or releases capital.; stages: label: Core seat: owner and capital lead; value: One full-time owner controls pricing and capital authorization.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own counterparty selection, capacity limits, charge economics, and final wire authorization. Maintain capital-provider agreements and decide whether a file meets the desk's mandate. Receive verification evidence from another person before authorizing funds.; label: Core seat: underwriting contractor; value: One contractor verifies transaction evidence and wire instructions.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review contracts, business-purpose facts, jurisdiction findings, payoff coverage, and settlement-agent records. Perform independent callbacks and preserve the evidence trail. In the core pod, this person verifies the beneficiary while the owner authorizes release.; label: Core seat: escrow-ledger contractor; value: One contractor reconciles principal, earned fees, and repayments.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the QuickBooks subledger and reconcile it against Qualia or SoftPro statements and bank records. Separate principal assets and obligations from revenue, track aged payoffs, and report unresolved variances without editing bank beneficiaries.; label: Scale addition: full-time operations lead; value: Add one full-time operator only in the scaled scenario.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own queue discipline, funding calendars, exposure aggregation, contractor scheduling, and escalation timing. Add this seat when measured file concurrency exceeds documented core-pod capacity, rather than treating the $950,000 revenue case as a three-person result.; label: Scale addition: wire-control contractor; value: Add one contractor for independent settlement verification capacity.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take primary responsibility for authenticated callbacks, beneficiary-change review, and archived verification records. The owner retains release authority; the underwriter retains transaction review. This addition brings the scaled pod to two full-time people and three contractors.

text.title: A Three-Person Core with Two Explicit Scale Additions
text.tspan: A Three-Person Core with Two Explicit Scale Additions

circle.title: label: Core seat: owner and capital lead; value: One full-time owner controls pricing and capital authorization.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own counterparty selection, capacity limits, charge economics, and final wire authorization. Maintain capital-provider agreements and decide whether a file meets the desk's mandate. Receive verification evidence from another person before authorizing funds.

text.title: Core seat: owner and capital lead

Own counterparty selection, capacity limits, charge economics, and final wire authorization. Maintain capital-provider agreements and decide whether a file meets the desk's mandate. Receive verification evidence from another person before authorizing funds.

circle.title: label: Core seat: underwriting contractor; value: One contractor verifies transaction evidence and wire instructions.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review contracts, business-purpose facts, jurisdiction findings, payoff coverage, and settlement-agent records. Perform independent callbacks and preserve the evidence trail. In the core pod, this person verifies the beneficiary while the owner authorizes release.

text.title: Review contracts, business-purpose facts, jurisdiction findings, payoff coverage, and settlement-agent records. Perform independent callbacks and preserve the evidence trail. In the core pod, this person verifies the beneficiary while the owner authorizes release.

circle.title: label: Core seat: escrow-ledger contractor; value: One contractor reconciles principal, earned fees, and repayments.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the QuickBooks subledger and reconcile it against Qualia or SoftPro statements and bank records. Separate principal assets and obligations from revenue, track aged payoffs, and report unresolved variances without editing bank beneficiaries.

text.title: Maintain the QuickBooks subledger and reconcile it against Qualia or SoftPro statements and bank records. Separate principal assets and obligations from revenue, track aged payoffs, and report unresolved variances without editing bank beneficiaries.

circle.title: label: Scale addition: full-time operations lead; value: Add one full-time operator only in the scaled scenario.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own queue discipline, funding calendars, exposure aggregation, contractor scheduling, and escalation timing. Add this seat when measured file concurrency exceeds documented core-pod capacity, rather than treating the $950,000 revenue case as a three-person result.

text.title: Own queue discipline, funding calendars, exposure aggregation, contractor scheduling, and escalation timing. Add this seat when measured file concurrency exceeds documented core-pod capacity, rather than treating the $950,000 revenue case as a three-person result.

circle.title: label: Scale addition: wire-control contractor; value: Add one contractor for independent settlement verification capacity.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take primary responsibility for authenticated callbacks, beneficiary-change review, and archived verification records. The owner retains release authority; the underwriter retains transaction review. This addition brings the scaled pod to two full-time people and three contractors.

text.title: Take primary responsibility for authenticated callbacks, beneficiary-change review, and archived verification records. The owner retains release authority; the underwriter retains transaction review. This addition brings the scaled pod to two full-time people and three contractors.

Assumptions: FT means full-time operator; C means contractor. Each node represents one person, not one full-time equivalent. The first three seats form the core pod; the last two are added only for the Scaled Small-Team scenario. Settlement agents and capital providers remain external counterparties rather than hidden pod headcount.
